Ordinance 2172-2026 was introduced June 16, 2026 and finally passed at the Council's July 14, 2026 meeting (notice published July 15, 2026), establishing a six-month moratorium on the approval, development, construction, expansion, and operation of data centers while the Planning Board and Environmental Commission study the issue. The moratorium is set to run through approximately January 10, 2027. No extension, repeal, or permanent ordinance was found in sources reviewed through 2026-09-23.

The prior January 10, 2027 endpoint was an unsupported 180-day calculation and is cleared.
